ignoreValues.reason: Verified false positive: the only positioned children involved (.stw-close/.stw-back, .cbx/.switch inputs, .row-grip) each have their own nearby position:relative ancestor and never need to escape body's or .stw's overflow:hidden; no popover/menu is actually clipped (menus/datepicker/pop are position:fixed and escape ancestor overflow regardless).

Verified false positive: .page-cover's only children (.cover-change/.cover-remove) are position:absolute with an explicit bottom:12px inset, not flush against the edge; the cover strip itself is an intentional edge-to-edge banner (Notion-style page cover) that must not get inner padding, which would shrink/break the full-bleed design.
